**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak) — "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation" — deployed 02:12–02:14 UTC. Right after it landed, the gateway's connection pool (cap 20) started running dry: `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, all 20 connections in use, waiting queue climbing steadily.

**Impact window:** Started 02:14:14 UTC 2026-03-14. Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27 UTC — never self-recovered. `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/checkout` all affected, across all three backend services. `/health` stayed green the whole time.

**Blast radius:** Gateway only. Checked `worker.log` for the same window — all jobs finished ok, no pool errors there. Not spreading past the gateway.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471`. No other deploy is close to the onset time.
